A1.justification: Both PDFs describe DockSmith and contain complete, readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–C. Textual and visual comparison supports reliable assessment; pages 6–19 are identical.

before.justification: v1 reports original DockSmith benchmark evaluations, training ablations, error analyses, and case-study outcomes in Section 3 and Appendices A–B.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Multi-Docker-Eval evaluations, downstream benchmark experiments, and appendix case studies.

M1.justification: Section 2 retains the same four-agent pipeline, loop-detection controller, cross-task memory, trajectory filtering, curriculum sampling, and fine-tuning procedures.

E1.justification: Training data coverage and evaluation on Multi-Docker-Eval, SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and Terminal-Bench 2.0 are unchanged. The appendix case-study tasks are also identical.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain the same comparators, including DeepSeek-v3.1, Kimi-K2-0905, and Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct. Comparator membership in the ablations, error analyses, and appendix cases is likewise unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 3.1 preserves the metrics, batch size of 32, learning rate of 1e-5, two training epochs, and 32K/64K sequence limits. Mixing-ratio experiments, matched-budget controls, and annotation procedures are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same mixing, filtering, and curriculum ablations; error-propagation and recovery analyses; and Appendix B case studies. No analytical question or supporting experiment is added or removed.

E5.justification: Table 4 still reports means over three runs, and Appendix B.2 still reports four independent reruns per model. Run-count disclosures and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings in Tables 1–9, Figures 2–4, and the appendix cases are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains DockSmith's 39.72% F2P and 58.28% Commit Rate.

T1.justification: Equation (1)'s complexity score and variable definitions are identical, as are the mathematical descriptions of error-transition probabilities. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs change.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims: environment construction is a core agentic capability, DockSmith achieves open-source state-of-the-art Docker-building performance, and its training supervision transfers to downstream tasks.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and qualifications are unchanged, including the effects of excessive Docker-data mixing and the tradeoff between stronger diagnostic reasoning and weaker low-level shell/environment resolution in Section 3.5.2.

D1.justification: Training details, appendix execution traces, annotation rubrics, and the model-and-trajectory access statement and link are unchanged. No reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 4, the bibliography, and positioning relative to SWE-Factory and earlier environment-setup systems are unchanged. No cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 removes Yanhao Li and Yingwei Ma and their associated affiliations from the author block and updates the preprint and arXiv dates. Scientific prose, headings, and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The revised front matter produces limited text reflow and different page/column breaks on pages 1–5. Figures, tables, and appendix listings retain their content and design; pages 6–19 render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 updates authorship, affiliations, and dates, with small accompanying layout shifts. The methods, evidence, interpretations, reproducibility information, and appendices remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful difference in scientific quality or explanatory clarity.
